purpose: Prioritize the smallest evidence-producing action that maximizes uncertainty reduction, risk reduction, dependency unlock, and academic reproducibility without claim promotion.

decision_model.name: FRONTIER_LEVERAGE_SCORE
decision_model.rule: If a required factor is not grounded, score_state=TOKEN_VAZIO_SCORE and no ranking promotion is allowed.

standards_operationalization.RFC_BCP14: Use uppercase MUST/SHOULD/MAY only for explicit normative requirements.
standards_operationalization.IEEE_1012: Separate verification of conformance from validation of intended use; use analysis, review, inspection, assessment and testing as evidence classes.
standards_operationalization.IEEE_ISO_IEC_29148: Requirements MUST be explicit, attributable, testable, and traceable through lifecycle changes.
standards_operationalization.ISO_IEC_27001_27005: Treat integrity, availability, confidentiality and security-risk treatment as controls around evidence and execution surfaces.
standards_operationalization.ISO_8000: Data quality MUST be measurable; raw, normalized and semantic forms remain distinguishable.
standards_operationalization.ISO_9001: Use process approach, risk-based thinking, documented information, measurement and continual improvement.

frontier.title: Federated current-state and deployment-authority reconciliation
frontier.falsifier: A newer authoritative source proves the recorded head, deployment authority, or policy state is stale or incorrect.
frontier.closure_criterion: Exactly one authoritative publication producer per surface OR an explicit namespaced multi-producer contract; Drive successor records exact heads and scoped run evidence.
frontier.rollback: successor receipt/revision only; no force push or history rewrite

frontier.title: RMR auxiliary parser fail-closed hardening with negative fixtures
frontier.falsifier: Negative fixtures demonstrate current implementation already rejects all bounded malformed cases.
frontier.closure_criterion: All bounded negative fixtures fail closed and positive fixtures round-trip without changing BLAKE3 core.

frontier.title: SYMBOL_GRAMMAR_V2 with Unicode and namespace adversarial tests
frontier.falsifier: Existing canonical registry already binds each targeted symbol unambiguously with equivalent fields and tests.
frontier.closure_criterion: Round-trip preserves raw glyph/codepoint and adversarial cases distinguish Δ/∆, ∅/0/TOKEN_VAZIO/NULL, μ namespaces and Ω sense collisions.
frontier.rollback: append-only successor; no retroactive semantic rewrite

frontier.title: RLL research-artifact reproducibility package and independent reproduction boundary
frontier.falsifier: An independent reproducer cannot obtain the scoped results from the frozen artifact under the documented environment.
frontier.closure_criterion: Artifact is documented, complete for scope, exercisable and independently reproduces declared scoped results; scientific claims remain separately gated.
frontier.rollback: supersede artifact release; preserve prior DOI/hash lineage

frontier.title: Isolated HASH→ERASURE→RIVER7→RECONSTRUCT→HASH experiment
frontier.falsifier: Any <=2 known-erasure case fails reconstruction+digest verification in the defined finite model.
frontier.closure_criterion: Finite-model experiment passes exhaustive <=2 erasures and fails closed outside supported conditions; no physical/storage claim.
frontier.rollback: lab-only removal; no production path replacement

frontier.title: Physical ARM32/ARM64 artifact→device receipts
frontier.falsifier: Exact artifact does not install or execute on the claimed ABI/device, or output diverges from bounded reference tests.
frontier.closure_criterion: Exact-hash artifacts execute on physical ARM32 and ARM64 with scoped receipts and no backfill from emulation.
frontier.rollback: per-repo/per-artifact rollback; no global history rewrite

selection.controller_step: Materialize this frontier control and use it to select one evidence-producing delta at a time.
selection.reason: Highest grounded leverage score and prerequisite for trustworthy cross-repository progression.
